label: [FTB]
title: A 30 m steel truss footbridge: moving crowd load, influence lines, member sizing, deflection and footfall frequency
question: For a 30 m simply supported Pratt through-truss footbridge with a 3 m deck, which arrangement of crowd governs each member, what sections does each group need, how far does it deflect, and how close is its first vertical frequency to walking pace?
written: 28 November 2026, before any solver for this bridge was run. The only number computed beforehand was a back-of-envelope first frequency of about 6 Hz from the beam formula, to see whether the 3 Hz limit was within reach. No limit below was changed after the run of record.
not_for_construction: A worked study. No licensed engineer has reviewed it. A plane model of one truss: nothing here covers wind, lateral vibration, connections, fatigue, the deck, bearings or foundations.

load_cases.what: steel self-weight times the connection allowance, plus the floor dead load on half the deck width, at the panel points

pedestrian load on half the deck width, placed for each member on exactly the lengths of deck where that member's influence line is positive (largest tension) and, separately, where it is negative (largest compression)
pedestrian load on the whole span, for deflection and as the comparison that shows what patterning adds
the crowd fills the deck from the left end to a front at x, for x from 0 to 30 m: the animation and the reversal plot

combinations.text: gamma N_DC + 1.75 w A_plus, with gamma 1.25 when dead load adds and 0.90 when it relieves
gamma N_DC + 1.75 w A_minus, same rule
N_DC + w A, unfactored, for deflection

requirements.shall: Every member's factored demand, in tension and in compression, under the patterned crowd shall be at most its design strength (utilisation at most 1.00).
Every member that can go into compression under any arrangement shall have KL/r at most 120, every other member at most 200, and every section's walls shall not be slender.
The midspan deflection under the unfactored pedestrian load on the whole span shall be at most span/360 = 83.3 mm.
The first vertical natural frequency of the bridge without people on it shall be at least 3.0 Hz.
The envelope shall come from the patterned load for all 37 members, and each member's governing arrangement shall be recorded as lengths of deck.
The truss shall be statically determinate and stable: 37 members = 2 x 20 joints - 3, and the equilibrium matrix shall have full rank.
Every number written into the X3D scene for a member shall equal the bank.

references.what: member forces under dead load from joint equilibrium (statics only) equal those from the stiffness method
OpenSeesPy 3.8, an independent finite element code, gives the same forces, the same midspan deflection and the same first frequency
method of sections: under a full uniform load the chord forces at midspan equal the beam moment over the depth

Mueller-Breslau: the influence line of a member's force found from unit loads equals minus the deflected shape of the deck when that member alone is lengthened by one unit (solved from the transpose of the equilibrium matrix)
closed forms: the midspan top chord influence line peaks at -a b/(L h) = -2.5; a diagonal's influence line changes sign inside its own panel
the patterned areas from exact integration equal a brute-force scan with 3,000 point loads
midspan deflection by virtual work equals the stiffness method's displacement
the first frequency lies between 0.75 and 1.00 of the Euler-Bernoulli beam formula built from the chords alone, because web shear flexibility can only lower it
the E3 buckling curve is continuous at KL/r = 4.71 sqrt(E/Fy)
